facts.fact: 谜团升级：Phaedra 曾有的初步信任因 hustled 协议当场破产（How ridiculous that suddenly seemed now.）
facts.anchor: Would have even gone as far as to say she had begun to somewhat trust the woman.

facts.fact: Syphon 问答课：Powerless 灵魂里也有能量（吸灵魂能量=夺命力、使其衰老）；大地海洋空气皆有能量
facts.anchor: Even without magic, there is still energy within one’s soul.

facts.fact: Felix 举一反三点破：Cursed King 吸大地之力致其黑腐死国
facts.anchor: That’s what the Cursed King of Tolanaa did, right?

facts.fact: 复扫 Felix：暗金色（dull gold）如常——试炼之力的天文量级在档案里不存在
facts.anchor: His energy appeared to her in spectral form, floating around his body.

facts.fact: 禁书计划立项：Syphon 之书锁在 librarium 的 Head Venerable 住处
facts.anchor: All except Syphons. Those are all locked away in the Head Venerable’s chambers located in the librarium.

facts.fact: Dark Voice 首度坦白：几年前才出现（母亲已离家）、从没对人说过、怕被惧怕地看待
facts.anchor: It hadn’t always been there. It was only over the last few years that it had started to appear

facts.fact: 她最大的恐惧：有一天 Voice 会赢
facts.anchor: Her biggest fear was that one day the Voice would win.
